items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: she thought that Booker T. Washington was the greatest educator in the world at that time

ctx.x: Looked like that was the name of her husband. Then I knew all the kids. The son's kids see, and she was sort of a, she was a grandmother. Madame Le Jeune. And she was always after me to go to school and finish up in New Orleans so she could send me to (Tuskegee). That's what she wanted because she thought that Booker T. Washington was the greatest educator in the world at that time, you know. And that's what she wanted me to do for mama, you know. She says, I just hope Zutty stay in school so I can send him to…
Well that was the right idea.
